text: A Gromark key is a stream of digits, each the sum of earlier digits. Each known letter under its carved letter tells the shift used there; a shift of 10 or more cannot be a digit.
Drawn for the rule 'five back plus four back' in base 26 on the standard and KRYPTOS alphabets: the stream must reproduce each later shift, and it does not.
184,512 alphabet triples, 364 two- and three-term rules with lags up to 13, bases 16 to 26: no rule survives six checks under any triple.
